payout_quote: You'll get Mint credit equivalent to their first payment based on whichever plan your pal chooses. So, if they choose a... 6GB plan, you get $45 in credit; 17GB plan, you get $60 in credit; 23GB plan, you'll get $75 in credit; Unlimited Plan, you'll get $90 in credit. Since you can refer 4 friends annually, in total you can earn up to $360 in credit. (Official Mint Mobile blog, crawled 2026-09-23)
timing: Credit posted about 15 days after the friend purchases and activates their plan
eligibility: Existing individual Mint Mobile customer; friend must purchase and activate a new Mint plan via your unique referral link; renewal credit for up to 4 referrals per calendar year
steps: Be an active Mint Mobile customer
Get your unique referral link from the Refer a Friend section of the Mint app
Share it with someone considering switching carriers
Friend buys and activates a Mint plan via your link
You get $45-$90 in renewal credit (based on their plan) about 15 days later; they get $15
catches: CREDITS ARE NOT CASH: they apply only toward plan renewals and cannot be redeemed or exchanged for cash or merchandise
Capped at 4 credited referrals per calendar year (max $360/year in credit)
Friend must purchase AND activate via your exact link - if they sign up any other way you get nothing
Individual customers only - no businesses or affiliate lead generation
Unused credit stays as a renewal balance; it never becomes withdrawable money
biggest_catch: This is phone-bill credit, not cash - it can zero out your Mint renewals but you can never withdraw it. And you're capped at 4 credited referrals a year.
notes: Official Mint Mobile blog + referral terms (mintmobile.com, crawled 2026-09-23): $45-$90 renewal credit per referral based on friend's plan, 4/year cap, friend gets $15. Repeatable per referral within cap. Framed honestly as bill credit, not cash.

repeatable.cadence: repeatable per referral, up to 4 credits per year ($360 max)

maximize: This is most valuable if you're already a happy Mint customer - your genuine recommendation converts better than any pitch. Target friends actively complaining about their carrier bill; the switch pitch writes itself. Since credit equals their first payment, steer friends toward the plan that fits them (don't upsell - a resentful referral churns and your reputation is worth more than the extra $45). Four referrals on Unlimited plans = $360, which covers a full year of your own Mint service.
